purpose: Determine whether all certified R0 same-image relations expose graph non-conformity leverage for a later bounded design review.

frozen_inputs.primary_graph_population: all certified relations before disjoint selection
frozen_inputs.selected_trace: archived selected pairs used only for parity and old-baseline comparison

edge_definition.orientation: strict base inversion i->j with m_bar_i < m_bar_j
edge_definition.base_order: float32 m_bar, descending value, ascending patch ID tie break
edge_definition.q_m: within-image percentile rank from that exact stable base order, rank/(1369-1)

hodge_definition.objective: minimize sum over certified edges of ((p_i-p_j)-g_ij)^2
hodge_definition.gauge: mean potential zero independently in every edge-connected component
hodge_definition.isolated_node_convention: potential zero, support degree zero, incident residual fraction null

node_signals.S6: deterministic within-image percentile rank of S5 over all 1369 nodes
node_signals.S7: incident residual-energy fraction; null for degree-zero nodes

gt_firewall.rule: materialize and hash all graph/node signals before any GT mask or label is read

frozen_gates.G0: integrity, cache/hash/count parity, GT-free barrier, zero forwards/training, protected hashes
frozen_gates.G1: aligned graph positive-contamination mass touched fraction >= 2x old selected fraction and increase in >=8/12 classes
frozen_gates.G2: aligned S6 positive-vs-negative rank-AUC class-bootstrap lower CI > 0.5
frozen_gates.G3: aligned-minus-shifted S6 AUC class-bootstrap lower CI > 0 and aligned > shifted in >=8/12 classes

forbidden: No Phase2B, R0, P5B, deployment, predictor, or protected-source edits
No new model forward, training, tuning, threshold search, AP optimization, or candidate implementation
No GT in graph construction, edge selection, node signal construction, or hashing
No post-hoc signal replacement or gate weakening
No dense maps, masks, or temporary NPZ committed
No D1 proposal unless the exact supported terminal is reached
